svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.26 ROOFING

g.text: Coal-tar and asphalt products used together: not permitted, (1)

svg.text: Coal-tar products and asphalt products are not
used together in built-up roof construction.
Layers exploded, thicknesses exaggerated. Coal-tar is drawn brown-black and asphalt blue-black to tell them apart.
